# Eden & Beyond

> Eden & Beyond is an independent multidisciplinary creative studio and collectible design brand founded by Maïja Disseau, based in Koh Phangan, Thailand. Two complementary sides: (1) The Collection — one-of-a-kind and limited-edition tables, lighting, artworks and dressed walls, available independently; and (2) The Studio — creative direction and design for hospitality, residential and commercial projects. Working in Thailand and internationally. Selected project: Dar Mansour, a Moroccan restaurant in Koh Phangan.
